title: Demographics/Working-Population/Education Time Series
description: Schema for pipeline outputs shaped like { metadata, india, peers } — used across the demographics, working-population, and education buckets.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the pipeline generated this file.

source.description: Data provider, e.g. 'World Bank Open Data API'.

country.description: ISO alpha-3 code of the primary country (India = IND).

peers.description: ISO alpha-3 codes of comparator countries, in display order.

indicator_code.description: Source indicator code, e.g. World Bank series code (SL.TLF.CACT.FM.NE.ZS).

label.description: Human-readable indicator name for chart titles/subtitles.

note.description: Optional interpretive note (e.g. explaining a derived/composite indicator).

peers.description: Keyed by ISO alpha-3 country code; each value is a year/value series.

value.description: Null when the source has no data for that year (never omit the year).
